verdict.rationale: Vercel documents securing 'every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider' (vercel-docs-13), implying some access-control mechanism for agents, but there is no concrete documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege API tokens or credentials specifically for AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit scoped API token/credential creation flow for agents, granularity of permissions, and independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
